item.overkill.sunline_rifle.flavor: "The light arrives first. The fire follows."
item.overkill.sunline_rifle.line2: 0.6s later the whole line detonates in fire
item.overkill.sunline_rifle.line3: Marked targets take +22 damage and Searing II
item.overkill.worldbreaker_cannon.line1: Hold right-click to charge: stages at 1s / 3s / 6s
item.overkill.worldbreaker_cannon.line2: Release to fire an orb that drills through anything
item.overkill.worldbreaker_cannon.line3: Full charge: a crater 30 wide and 40 deep
item.overkill.worldbreaker_cannon.line4: Hold a full charge too long and it backfires!
item.overkill.riftfang_scythe.flavor: "Every cut opens a door. None of them lead anywhere kind."
item.overkill.riftfang_scythe.line1: Hits leave tears in space that drop enemies from the sky
item.overkill.riftfang_scythe.line3: Sneak + right-click: Void Harvest (20 blocks, 30s recharge)
item.overkill.stormcaller_gauntlet.flavo: "Every blow is a promise of thunder."
item.overkill.stormcaller_gauntlet.line1: Punches store charge and arc chain lightning
item.overkill.stormcaller_gauntlet.line2: Look up + right-click: Thunder Call on recent targets
item.overkill.gravemaker.flavor: "Gravity is a weapon if you are rude enough."
item.overkill.gravemaker.line1: Right-click: launch a black hole (4s pull, then collapse)
item.overkill.gravemaker.line2: Sneak + right-click: white hole blast (launches you too)
item.overkill.gravemaker.line3: Ripped-up terrain is flung out when it collapses
death.attack.overkill.worldbreaker: %1$s was unmade by a Worldbreaker orb
death.attack.overkill.backfire: %1$s overcharged a Worldbreaker and paid the price
death.attack.overkill.backfire.player: %1$s was caught in a Worldbreaker backfire whilst fighting %2$s
death.attack.overkill.rift: %1$s fell through a tear in space
death.attack.overkill.storm: %1$s was struck down by the storm
death.attack.overkill.electrified.player: %1$s was fried by static whilst fighting %2$s
